subject: ACME procurement + security gating — next steps (PO vs Card, SOC 2/DPA)
messages:

Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement & security gating (PO vs card, SOC 2/DPA)

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What we heard from ACME:
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood for customer-facing LLM features in Sponsor Portal (high throughput, predictable latency).
- Timeline: procurement kick-off this quarter; target go-live pilot in Q3.
- Procurement orientation: prefer PO/vendor setup for enterprise purchases (not card), legal review required.

Security/compliance gating we discussed:
- ACME needs current SOC 2 report and an executed DPA before production access.
- They also requested we complete their security questionnaire (attached to this thread).

Commercial path options we discussed:
1) Marketplace procurement (preferred by some internal teams) — ACME evaluating marketplace listing as an option if it avoids vendor setup friction.
2) Direct PO via AP (standard vendor onboarding).
3) Short-term card to start pilot (if vendor setup timeline slips) — needs finance approval.

Action items / next steps:
- Marissa / Rishi: send SOC 2 summary + draft DPA and our completed security questionnaire answers (today).
- ACME (Sam / Jordan / Tanya): confirm preferred route (PO vs marketplace vs starter card) and procurement timeline.
- Plan a 30-min follow-up with procurement + security to align on gating items and paperwork (propose Wed 6/30 or Thu 7/1).

Attachments: ACME security questionnaire (you sent it during the call) — we'll populate answers and attach.

I'll attach the SOC 2 summary and DPA draft shortly. LMK if you'd like me to loop in our legal or finance partners now.

Best,

Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

Procurement preferences:
- ACME prefers PO and vendor onboarding for anything that moves beyond a pilot.
- For an initial pilot, procurement can sign off on a short-term card if Redwood confirms we won't exceed spend limits and we provide usage/cost estimates up front.
- Marketplace is interesting but requires our legal to confirm contract terms — that could be slower than our internal PO process in this case.

Timeline:
- Procurement kick-off: target this week (we have an internal vendor onboarding slot next Tuesday, 7/6).
- Legal / security review: expect ~2-3 weeks once we receive SOC 2 + DPA + questionnaire responses.

Security asks (from Tanya):
- SOC 2 Type II report (recent) or SOC 2 summary that lists scope.
- Completed security questionnaire (we'll prioritize the sections on data residency, retention, and access controls).
- DPA draft for ACME to review — send any standard redlines you anticipate.

I'll confirm with procurement which path they want (PO vs card) and update you by end of day.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

- Sam
VP Product, ACME Corp.
